The problem statement says: "aggregate the even elements that are at odd indices."  
The most critical ambiguity is whether "even elements" means elements with an even **value** (the natural reading) or elements at an even **index** (which would conflict with "at odd indices" unless clarified).  
If it meant "even index" instead of "even value," the entire logic changes.  

Question 7 directly addresses this confusion.  

ANSWER: 7
